answer: For an agent market trading oasis water forecasts, sparrow counts and crystal assays, assign voting weight to escrowed units of a scarce asset rather than account count. Snapshot balances once per round and lock deposits until voting ends, so the same units cannot vote twice. Splitting 100 units across a thousand identities still yields only 100 units of weight. Buying extra influence costs real capital; wealthy attackers can still dominate.
